visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The creator, a man with a short beard and a light beige suit jacket over a crisp white t-shirt, addresses the camera in a selfie perspective. He stands before a vibrant red wall adorned with the MICHELIN GUIDE CEREMONY 2025 TAIWAN logo. His facial expressions are animated, with wide eyes and frequent smiles as he gestures towards the event signage. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom of the screen to transcribe his enthusiastic speech. (2) The scene cuts to the man walking through wide open doors into a massive, well-lit banquet hall. The background is filled with formally dressed attendees and waitstaff moving through the space. The lighting transitions from the saturated red of the lobby to a bright, natural indoor glow. He continues to speak to the camera while navigating the crowd, occasionally glancing around at the scale of the event. (3) He stops in front of a series of large digital banners displaying images of gourmet dishes like beef noodles. He uses his index finger to point at specific restaurant names on the boards. The background shows other attendees also observing the displays. The camera work is slightly shaky, reflecting the handheld selfie nature of the filming style while he provides commentary. (4) A wide shot captures the dramatic entrance of several chefs dressed in pristine white culinary jackets. They walk along a long red carpet towards a brightly illuminated stage. A large crowd of guests is seated on either side, many of whom are holding up smartphones to record the procession. The setting is grand, with high ceilings and sophisticated event lighting. (5) The creator returns to the frame, appearing alongside another man wearing glasses who waves cheerfully to the camera. The lighting shifts to a pinkish-red hue from the stage's atmospheric lights. The creator's face is lit from the side, highlighting his excited smile as they seem to enjoy the spectacle together. (6) Multiple shots display the large LED screens on stage, which list the 2025 Michelin Star winners for Taiwan. The lists are divided into One, Two, and Three-star categories in both Chinese and English. A personified Michelin mascot, the large white Bibendum, stands on stage alongside groups of chefs holding red award books. The framing is mostly medium shots focusing on the announcements. (7) The final segment shifts to a more intimate moment on stage where a host in a dark suit interviews a chef in a white uniform. The chef is visibly emotional, using his hands to wipe tears from his face as he receives a new chef's coat embroidered with a Michelin star. The host and the Michelin mascot stand nearby, offering support in the brightly lit stage environment.

The collective chatter of a large crowd becomes more prominent, creating a dense acoustic atmosphere. The BGM remains continuous but is mixed slightly lower to prioritize the narration. This is interrupted by sudden bursts of loud applause and cheering from the audience, which has high spectral bandwidth and high intensity. The host's voice on the PA system sounds enunciated and clear, cutting through the music. The primary vocal (the chef) exhibits low-intensity speech with audible breathiness and occasional pauses, suggesting an emotional state. The crowd noise remains as a soft, rhythmic clapping bed in the background. (5) The audio concludes with a return to the vlogger's high-arousal speech, delivered at a fast rate with high confidence. The upbeat pop BGM returns to full volume, syncing with the faster editing pace. A final ding or bell SFX signals the end of the informative segment, with the speaker's voice maintaining high dominance until the fade-out.
